messages:
Susan: Heads-up — need a quick sync on the Marketplace + HW partner SLA + SI joint announce plan. Targeting Nov launch window. @Mike @Deepa @Owen @Sarah @Raj please chime in with blockers.
Mike: +1. High level legal asks: redistribution rights, export control checklist, attribution language, indemnity carveouts for model weights. I can draft an addendum but need the model licensing metadata.
Deepa: Product note — we need to decide hosting model: (A) Marketplace-hosted inference endpoint, or (B) Marketplace as download + self-hosted by customer. Each has different telemetry & compliance implications. Also need perf profile for quantized vs fp16.
Owen: From eng infra: For (A) we need a signed model bundle containing manifest.json, model weights (fp16 + q4_0), sha256 sums, and a minimal runtime test harness. For (B) we need packaging + an attestable checksum flow so SIs can validate. Example manifest snippet below:
```
{
  "name": "vendor-open-13b",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "weights": ["vendor-open-13b-fp16.bin","vendor-open-13b-q4.bin"],
  "checksums": {"fp16":"<sha256>","q4":"<sha256>"},
  "license": "custom-syndication-addendum-v1"
}
```
Owen: Also: need guidance on KV-cache persistence and prefix-caching behavior if we host — affects memory/cost and SLA.
Raj: HW partner ask: they want a co-bundled SKU (HW + model), plus a latency SLA for 95th percentile at typical prompt size (512 tokens). They also expect a joint announcement and a 30-day co-marketing window.
Sarah: PMM/Marketing: For PR we need embargo dates, logo usage, joint quotes, and one consolidated assets pack. I can draft a one-pager if we lock the technical details this week.
Mike: Draft legal clause for redistribution to start from (very rough):
```
"Distributor may host and serve Model Weights subject to the Addendum. Distributor will not republish weights for redistribution outside the Marketplace. Export controls in Appendix B apply."
```
Mike: Also flag: if model has third-party training data restrictions we need the provenance statement and dataset opt-outs.
Deepa: Quick product checklist I need from vendor: perf matrix (latency/cost by variant), preferred quant configs, provenance statement, attestations for curated safety filters, and a contact for security scans.
Susan: Action items summary —
- Mike: draft Addendum + sample clause by Thu EOD (2615080000).
- Deepa: vendor to provide perf matrix + provenance by Wed.
- Owen: produce model bundle spec + test harness example; confirm KV-cache guidance by Wed.
- Sarah: mock PR timeline + assets list by Thu.
- Raj: confirm HW SKU requirements and draft joint offer terms with partner rep.
I'll book a 30-min follow-up Friday 11:00am PT (inv sent).
Susan: :thumbsup:
legal-bot: Reminder — confidentiality checklist not completed for vendor. Upload NDA to https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace/onboarding when ready.
Owen: Noted — I'll create the artifact template in the repo and ping the SI lead with build steps.
Deepa: If anyone wants to review the perf template before we send it to vendor, ping me.
Sarah: I'll loop in comms for embargo coordination once we have the legal addendum draft.
Mike: If vendor pushes any dual-license terms, escalate to me immediately.
Susan: Thanks all — short sync pending after deliverables.
